labs.name: Medical Imaging and AI Lab
labs.description: Deep learning for radiology images: tumor segmentation in MRI and CT, chest X-ray screening, and explainable diagnostic models.

labs.name: Language Intelligence Lab
labs.description: Builds language models and chatbots for Indian languages, sentiment analysis, code-mixed text and machine translation.

labs.name: Autonomous Systems Lab
labs.description: Mobile robots, drone navigation, SLAM and motion planning, with applications in warehouse logistics and vehicle routing.

labs.name: Solar and Storage Research Lab
labs.description: Photovoltaic performance monitoring, battery energy storage, degradation modelling and smart grid integration.

labs.name: Climate Data Lab
labs.description: Rainfall and monsoon forecasting, satellite remote sensing and climate impact analysis for agriculture.

labs.name: Computational Genomics Lab
labs.description: Gene expression analysis, DNA sequencing pipelines, cancer biomarker discovery and protein structure prediction.

labs.name: Secure Systems Lab
labs.description: Network intrusion detection, malware analysis, applied cryptography and privacy-preserving machine learning.

labs.name: Advanced Materials Lab
labs.description: Nanomaterials, anti-corrosion coatings, polymers and electrode materials for batteries.

labs.name: Precision Agriculture Lab
labs.description: Crop disease detection from leaf images, soil sensors, irrigation scheduling and yield prediction.

labs.name: Smart City and Mobility Lab
labs.description: Traffic congestion prediction, IoT sensor deployments, public transport analytics and urban planning.

labs.name: Bio-Signal Processing Lab
labs.description: ECG and EEG signal analysis and wearable sensing, with growing work on medical image reconstruction.

datasets.name: Chest X-ray Screening Subset
datasets.description: 12,000 de-identified chest X-ray images with radiologist labels for pneumonia and nodule screening.

datasets.name: Brain MRI Tumor Segmentation Set
datasets.description: 480 annotated brain MRI volumes with tumor masks; access limited to approved student projects.

datasets.name: Indian-Language News Corpus
datasets.description: 1.2 million news articles in Hindi, Punjabi and English for language-model training and text classification.

datasets.name: Code-Mixed Hindi-English Tweets
datasets.description: 60,000 tweets labelled for sentiment and offensive language, useful for chatbots and sentiment analysis.

datasets.name: Warehouse Robot Trajectory Logs
datasets.description: Sensor and trajectory logs from 8 mobile robots operating in a warehouse mock-up, including route plans.

datasets.name: Rooftop Solar Generation Logs
datasets.description: Two years of minute-level generation data from 40 rooftop photovoltaic panels on campus.

datasets.name: Battery Cycling Degradation Data
datasets.description: Charge-discharge cycling records of lithium-ion cells for battery ageing and storage research.

datasets.name: District Rainfall 1990-2020
datasets.description: Daily rainfall and temperature for Punjab districts, suitable for monsoon forecasting models.

datasets.name: Satellite Crop NDVI Time Series
datasets.description: Satellite vegetation-index time series for wheat and paddy fields, linked to weather and yield records.

datasets.name: Plant Leaf Disease Images
datasets.description: 25,000 labelled leaf photographs of healthy and diseased crops for crop disease classification.

datasets.name: Cancer Gene Expression Cohort
datasets.description: RNA gene expression profiles from a patient cohort; restricted pending ethics approval.

datasets.name: Network Intrusion Flow Records
datasets.description: Labelled network traffic flows covering malware, port scans and denial-of-service attacks.

datasets.name: City Traffic Sensor Feed
datasets.description: Six months of traffic counts and speeds from 120 road sensors for congestion prediction.

datasets.name: Alloy Corrosion Measurements
datasets.description: Corrosion rate measurements for coated and uncoated alloys under salt-spray exposure.

facilities.name: GPU Compute Cluster
facilities.description: Shared cluster of 16 GPUs for training large deep learning models; booked per week.

facilities.name: Sequencing Core Facility
facilities.description: Next-generation DNA sequencing service with bioinformatics support.

facilities.name: Robotics Arena
facilities.description: Indoor arena with motion-capture for testing drones and mobile robot navigation.

facilities.name: Solar Test Field
facilities.description: Outdoor photovoltaic test field with calibrated irradiance and panel performance instrumentation.

facilities.name: Electron Microscopy Centre
facilities.description: Scanning electron microscope for nanomaterial, coating and thin-film characterisation.

facilities.name: Cyber Range
facilities.description: Isolated virtual network for safe malware experiments and attack simulation.

facilities.name: Weather Station Network
facilities.description: 12 automatic weather stations across the campus farm and district for rainfall and climate records.

facilities.name: IoT Testbed
facilities.description: Testbed of wireless sensor nodes for smart city and secure IoT experiments.
